narrative.summary: Togo has no AI-specific law or published AI strategy. AI is governed indirectly by the 2019 personal data protection law, which restricts decisions based solely on automated processing, and by a 2025 communiqué from the data protection authority (IPDCP) setting its expectations on platforms using published personal content to train AI systems. A national AI strategy and an AI governance framework within a planned Digital Code are in preparation.

Instance de Protection des Données à Caractère Personnel (IPDCP)
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026 from the Official Journal and the digital ministry's and data protection authority's websites. Not yet verified from the official text: material from the cybersecurity agency and the National Assembly, and the content of the cybersecurity laws, which are available only as scans. The national AI strategy, the Digital Code and the cybersecurity laws are tracked as leads.

instruments.current_status: Published in the Journal officiel de la République togolaise, 64th year, No. 26 ter (special issue) of 29 October 2019. Art. 97 provides that the law is executed as a law of the State; no separate entry-into-force date is stated, and Art. 95 gives existing processing a compliance period from entry into force. The supervisory authority it creates, the IPDCP, publishes the law on its own site and is operational. No AI-specific law exists in Togo as of 11 October 2026.
instruments.summary: Togo's general data protection law regulating the collection, processing, transmission, storage and use of personal data, with declaration and prior-authorisation regimes (e.g. for biometric, genetic and health data) and data-subject rights including access, opposition (Art. 45) and rectification. Art. 27 bars court decisions that assess a person's conduct, and any decision producing legal effects, from being based solely on automated processing intended to profile the person or evaluate aspects of their personality. It creates the Instance de protection des données à caractère personnel (IPDCP) as the independent supervisory authority with sanctioning powers.

instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Togolese national law governing personal data used to train and run AI systems; Art. 27 sets the rule on solely automated decisions and profiling.

coverage_audit.no_material_found_note: Togo's official journal, the digital ministry, other ministries and regulators were searched. No qualifying AI-governance document was found for strategy, government AI governance, ethics, risk and assurance, the public sector, procurement, cybersecurity, transparency, standards, sandboxes, readiness indices, sectoral rules, drafts, international agreements or historical publications. The cybersecurity laws are scanned images, so possible AI provisions in those laws and pending AI bills are still to be checked.
coverage_audit.technical_note:
Coverage note (original): Technical review notes: tier B/C batch run 2026-10-12, one agent, national level only (PROTOCOL §6), about 25-minute time box. ancy.tg / anssi.tg unreachable (curl, WebFetch); assemblee-nationale.tg expired cert / 503. jo.gouv.tg full-text search for AI terms, automated processing, Convention 108. Law 2019-014 source jo.gouv.tg/node/15411 (PDF identical to ministry copy); effective_date null (Art. 97). IPDCP communiqué undated PDF; date from WordPress post record (2025-05-03, modified 2025-07-26); in scope as regulator expectation on AI training. Togo Digital 2025 strategy (2022) read: no AI pillar (lead). Laws 2018-026 and 2022-009 image-only scans (lead). BCEAO regional. Convention 108 act not found. Units covered: Law: Journal officiel (jo.gouv.tg) full-text search run: no AI-specific law, decree or order; Law 2019-014 on personal data (Art. 27 automated decisions) recorded. Cybersecurity law 2018-026 and amending law 2022-009 are image-only scans and could not be text-searched (lead). National Assembly site unreachable (expired certificate, then 503); no AI bill found via other searches.; Government: Ministry of Digital Economy and Digital Transformation (numerique.gouv.tg) searched through its site search and full documentation list: no national AI strategy, AI policy, public-sector AI guideline or AI procurement rule published; strategy in preparation and Digital Code AI framework held as leads; Togo Digital 2025 read, no AI pillar (lead).; Ministries: Searched, nothing found: no AI documents from education, health, justice, defence, finance, labour or interior ministries found on the gazette or by web search.; Regulators: IPDCP (data protection) searched in full: one AI communiqué recorded; no AI recommendations or decisions. ARCEP (telecoms) searched: no AI documents. National cybersecurity agency (ANCy, ancy.tg) unreachable (DNS/proxy failure on curl and WebFetch). Central bank is regional (BCEAO), out of national scope; no national financial supervisor AI documents.. Not reached: Agence nationale de la cybersécurité (ancy.tg; anssi.tg also failed): unreachable via curl and WebFetch; Assemblée nationale (assemblee-nationale.tg): expired TLS certificate on curl, HTTP 503 on WebFetch. Could not verify: Cybersecurity law 2018-026 and amending law 2022-009: scanned PDFs, no text layer; AI/deepfake provisions not checked.; ANCy (national cybersecurity agency) site unreachable.; National Assembly site unreachable; pending AI bills could not be checked there.; Convention 108: no Togolese accession act found in the Journal officiel search; Togo is not believed to be a party (set null).. strategy, government-governance, ethics, risk-assurance, public-sector, procurement, cyber-security, transparency, standards, sandbox, index-readiness, sectoral, drafts, international, historical: no material found.
